product.name: Stage Right by Monoprice 200-watt 2-in-1 Warm and Cool White LED COB Ellipsoidal with Manual Zoom
product.description: The Stage Right™ by Monoprice™ 200‑watt 2‑in‑1 Warm and Cool White LED COB Ellipsoidal Stage Light is perfect for any application that requires brilliant, pro‑level lighting. It is a great stage illuminating solution for theaters, clubs, churches, conventions, and much more.              This ellipsoidal stage light features a 200‑watt 2‑in‑1 warm and cool white COB LED light with zoom capabilities. The COB design increases the lighting area to avoid uncomfortable glare. With an adjustable manual zoom of 17° ~ 50° and 4 independently adjustable shutters, you can get very efficient light placement. This fixture is DMX‑ready, with 2 or 6 channel mode settings. This enables full control as a standalone fixture or daisy chained in a multi‑light system utilizing the Master/Slave mode.
